disease.description: An autosomal dominant movement disorder characterized by attacks of dystonia, chorea, and athetosis. The attacks of involuntary movements are brought on by stress, alcohol, fatigue or caffeine, and generally last between a few seconds and four hours or longer. The attacks may begin in one limb and spread throughout the body, including the face.
